expected_dmg.formula: active = 180 (x2 vs Grass weakness); plus 30 fixed to 1 chosen opponent benched Pokemon (ignores Weakness/Resistance)

early.on_plan: own_active is Impidimp(646) by T1-2; bench has Munkidori+Snorunt+spare Impidimp; Spikemuth Gym in play; evolution line (648 + RareCandy/Morgrem) in hand or fetched by Dawn/Spikemuth by T2-3

mid.on_plan: Shadow Bullet used every turn (180+30); >=1 Munkidori has Darkness energy so Adrena-Brain fires; Froslass in play; bench-30 and Adrena-Brain aimed at the SAME finish-off target

late.on_plan: Boss's Orders pulls a KOable/high-value target; chain 2nd Grimmsnarl via Night Stretcher+Rare Candy; Unfair Stamp only after own KO; keep attacking every turn

hypotheses.claim: Munkidori(112) is a type-dead attacker (Mind Bend needs [P][C], deck has no Psychic); it must be used as an ability engine only and receive at most 1 Darkness energy, never be set active as an attacker
hypotheses.expect: 0 < share_per_Munkidori <= 1 energy; first_attack_turn attributed to 112 == never
hypotheses.violation_symptom: energy to type-dead mon / key ability play_rate ~0
hypotheses.pattern: エネが意図しないポケモンへ

hypotheses.claim: Munkidori must be hand-attached 1 Darkness to turn on Adrena-Brain; Punk Up cannot fuel it (Marnie's-only, verified). If engine dumps all hand attaches on Grimmsnarl, Adrena-Brain never fires and Froslass self-damage accumulates on own Munkidori (observed 70/110)
hypotheses.expect: trigger_fire[adrena_brain] > 0 per game once 648 online; own Munkidori KO'd by self-chip == rare
hypotheses.violation_symptom: キーカードのプレイ率~0
hypotheses.pattern: 発火条件を盤面/手札の所持状態ベースに置換

hypotheses.claim: Punk Up (up to 5 Darkness from deck on evolve) should not be dumped 5-on-one; put ~2 on active Grimmsnarl and pre-load a 2nd Marnie's line for chaining, not stockpile dead energy on one attacker
hypotheses.expect: active Grimmsnarl energy caps ~2-3; remainder spread to bench Marnie's line
hypotheses.violation_symptom: エネが意図しないポケモンへ / 主砲KO後に殴れない
hypotheses.pattern: デッキ固有の給餌計画（先貼り・キャップ・順序）

hypotheses.claim: Snorunt(103)/Froslass(104) are zero-energy ability pieces (Frost Smash type-dead); they must never receive energy and never be left active
hypotheses.violation_symptom: エネが意図しないポケモンへ
hypotheses.pattern: ベンチ許可リスト＋上限

hypotheses.claim: The scale components (Shadow Bullet bench-30, Adrena-Brain 30x#Munkidori, Freezing Shroud 10) should be promoted to shared perception and concentrated on ONE finish-off bench target rather than spread randomly
hypotheses.expect: bench-30 and Adrena-Brain land on same target on >50% of turns where a bench KO is reachable
hypotheses.violation_symptom: スケール技が過小評価される
hypotheses.pattern: 実打点式を共有知覚に昇格

hypotheses.claim: Lillie's Determination shuffles hand into deck; playing it while holding combo pieces (648/RareCandy/needed energy) throws away the win. It should be gated on hand NOT containing key pieces
hypotheses.expect: Lillie's rarely played on a turn where 648 or 1079 is in hand and usable
hypotheses.violation_symptom: キーカードがトラッシュ/山で勝ち筋喪失
hypotheses.pattern: 回収/ドローカードの所持ベース発火

hypotheses.claim: Boss's Orders should gust a Pokemon KOable by Shadow Bullet 180 or a high-value engine piece, not be wasted early; generic 'gust on 60+ damage' under-values the 180 line and the 2-prize math
hypotheses.expect: Boss targets are KO'd same turn or are prize-dense; play_rate[1182] weighted to mid/late
hypotheses.pattern: サイド期待値・実打点ベースの対象選択

hypotheses.claim: Retreat is expensive on the tank (Grimmsnarl cost 2) and cheap on support (cost 1). Retreat should serve promoting Impidimp/demoting a stuck support mon, NOT ping-ponging the loaded Grimmsnarl
hypotheses.expect: retreat_count low; Grimmsnarl(648) retreat_share ~0; no generic retreat ping-pong
hypotheses.violation_symptom: 攻撃せず抱え込み/遅延

hypotheses.claim: Spikemuth Gym search is one-sided (opponent has no Marnie's Pokemon); it should be kept in play and its Marnie's search used every turn for consistency
hypotheses.expect: trigger_fire[spikemuth_search] fires on most turns while stadium is ours
hypotheses.violation_symptom: キーカードのプレイ率~0
hypotheses.pattern: 発火条件を所持状態ベースに

hypotheses.claim: Once Grimmsnarl is online the deck must attack every turn (Shadow Bullet); passivity is harmful and there is no reason to hold
hypotheses.violation_symptom: 攻撃せず抱え込み/遅延

hypotheses.claim: If Grimmsnarl is delayed, Morgrem Corkscrew Punch (60, [D][D]) should be used as a bridge attacker instead of not attacking

hypotheses.violation_symptom: 攻撃せず抱え込み/遅延

hypotheses.claim: Bench composition should be capped (Impidimp x2, Munkidori x1-2, Snorunt/Froslass x1); over-benching Munkidori/Grimmsnarl increases Froslass self-chip surface and gives Boss more high-value targets
